name: x402-agent-service
title: x402 Agent Microservice (Base USDC)
description: Model Context Protocol server for autonomous x402 payment-gated microservices on Base Mainnet. Generates dynamic crossword puzzles ($0.50 USDC) and validates email schemas with DNS MX resolution ($0.25 USDC).

tools.name: x402_get_service_info
tools.description: Discover protocol specifications, active pricing, payee wallet, and token details.

tools.name: x402_simulate_challenge
tools.description: Dry-run calling an endpoint to inspect the HTTP 402 challenge and payment instructions without spending gas or tokens.

tools.name: x402_generate_crossword
tools.description: Generate dynamic crossword grid with progressive hints and rebus cells ($0.50 USDC on Base).

tools.name: x402_verify_email
tools.description: Validate email syntax RFC 5322 & query live DNS MX host records ($0.25 USDC on Base).

tools.name: x402_execute_payment
tools.description: Direct onchain settlement helper to execute USDC transfers on Base Mainnet to recipient wallet 0x3028C30B8c8985Bd54669BC313Fe7950fCeB1142.
